scope: SAE J2601 Tables Method normalization and downstream development analyses
trigger: Closed-loop mass-flow timing diagnostics showed that H2P-L29 delivered essentially none of its measured mass during the first half of the old normalized interval while the simulated fill began immediately.
root_cause: The former parser selected the first and last above-threshold sample. A negligible isolated 1.526 g/s pulse at workbook time zero therefore pulled the start 369.5 s ahead of the sustained fill.

correction.algorithm: Cluster above-threshold flow samples using a 15 s maximum gap, discard leading or trailing clusters below max(0.005 kg, 0.2% of total cluster mass), and retain meaningful multi-segment fills including their internal gaps.
correction.tests: A regression test rejects a negligible leading pulse while existing meaningful multi-segment cases remain intact.

evidence_role: The corrected tank and development results supersede the old Tables Method normalization. The eight MC Default workbooks use a separate parser and remain a consumed historical external failure of their frozen model; they were not rerun or used for tuning.
